deadline.value: Fall entry closes February 15, or January 15 for international applicants.

supervisor.value: Applicants need a letter from a Geosciences faculty member willing to supervise them.
supervisor.quote: Letter of support from a Geoscience faculty member with willingness to supervise the applicant’s doctoral research

funding.value: Many full-time students hold teaching or research assistantships; the page does not promise funding to all.
funding.quote: Many full-time graduate students receive financial support in the form of teaching and/or research assistantship

also.quote: The doctoral TA stipend is $26,000 for 12 months.

entry_route.value: Only an undergraduate degree with a 3.0 GPA is listed for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Undergraduate GPA 3.0 from regionally accredited college or university

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test is mentioned for this program.

notes: The Geosciences MS is a separate program and is not saved here.
